purpose: Finite independent screens of two source-motivated optimizations after correctness repair
combined_candidate_rule: Only consider a combined candidate if independent results support the contributing candidates; no repeated attempts to seek a pass
p99_comparison: Exact inclusive nanosecond histogram intervals; conservative entire ratio bound must satisfy the threshold. Excess variability or threshold overlap prevents support.
required: Every run passes existing correctness, allocation, GC and stability checks; unchanged paired retry/arena limits
quiet_window: No overlapping builds, tests, provers, profiler or benchmark jobs; preserved executables only
inconclusive_followup: Sparse separate phase/lock/queue instrumentation or controlled longer study; do not repeat short screens seeking green
workload_seed_limitation: Original Crucible seed_rng mixes worker/salt with PID and SystemTime. These paired runs share the operation distribution and fixture, but not exact row-choice PRNG streams. Scheduler and input-sequence effects cannot be separated from these outputs. Preserve fixture unchanged for both first diagnostics; any future deterministic-seed patch must be identical on both references and candidates.
